facts.fact: The PDPO decided Complaint PDPO 061/2024 against Chipper Technologies Uganda Limited on 12 March 2025, finding no infringement but directing it to amend its privacy notice to require explicit consent beyond regulatory compliance, as summarised by DRAA on 31 August 2025.
